items.title: Expose DONE closure runbook from existing DONE pre-check data
items.context: Add or extend a CLI surface that projects remaining closure gates between the current phase and DONE. Prefer reusing session_brief/next or existing done-oracle data over duplicating gate predicates. The surface must be read-only by default and include branch sync, delivery-check, summary, validation, bug, evidence freshness, declared artifact, and related-doc advisory state.
items.userSees: User runs lattice done_closure --storyId=B-cd1e and sees local DONE readiness, ordered closure blockers, and next commands derived from DONE pre-check rows.

happy.desc: done_closure on a TEST story renders local DONE readiness from buildDoneChecklist rows and lists blockers in gate order.

edge.desc: done_closure on a non-TEST or already-DONE story returns a clear read-only projection without mutating phase or artifacts.

adversarial.desc: done_closure output stays consistent with session_brief/DONE oracle rows and cannot report canAttemptDone=true while blocking DONE rows remain.

items.title: Separate localNonAuthorityAudit from authorityServerPath in output
items.context: The runbook must mechanically distinguish local lifecycle/DONE readiness from Authority Server receipt-backed completion. Local CLI/two-host evidence must not set or imply receiptVerified, authorityDone, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone.
items.userSees: User sees localNonAuthorityAudit and authorityServerPath as separate sections, with Authority completion shown as NOT_CLAIMED unless verified receipt proof exists.

happy.desc: done_closure JSON includes localNonAuthorityAudit and authorityServerPath as separate objects.

edge.desc: When no Authority receipt refs exist, authorityServerPath reports receiptVerified=false and mayClaimAuthorityDone=false.

adversarial.desc: Local validation/reviewer evidence cannot cause done_closure to emit receiptVerified, authorityDone, productionDone, or fullAuthorityDone success claims.

items.title: Register process-fact and command contracts consistently
items.context: If adding a command or extending an existing surface, update CLI schema/registry, command policy/process-fact registry, and contract verification so the capability is classified as read-only lifecycle observability rather than gate evidence or Authority proof.
items.userSees: User sees done_closure listed as a read-only lifecycle observability command rather than gate evidence or Authority proof.

happy.desc: Command policy and process-fact registry classify done_closure as read-only lifecycle observability.

edge.desc: Contract verification fails if done_closure is missing from the expected read-only command/process-fact surfaces.

adversarial.desc: done_closure is not classified as gateEvidence and does not become a producer for delivery-check, summary, or Authority receipt facts.

items.title: Add regression coverage for TEST PASS not equal DONE
items.context: Add focused tests proving a TEST story with passing validation but missing delivery-check/summary is reported as not DONE, local Non-authority closure cannot claim Authority fields, and Authority guidance remains receipt-backed.
